messages:
alex_support: FYI received a request from Acme Media — they want a one-week throughput bump for live-captioning (estimated 8x normal usage). asking if we can do temporary uplift and what fraud checks to run.
sam_sales: thx alex. they're paying enterprise plan but not on a dedicated pool yet. Sales asked for 48h burst to handle a promo.
julie_ops: 8x is big. what's their current qps / token rate? need to check recent usage + error spikes.
alex_support: current avg is ~120 reqs/min, 1.2M tokens/day. they want ~10M tokens/day for 7 days. no unusual error patterns in last 90d.
eng_oncall: at that level, hosted pool could auto-scale but we'd risk noisy-neighbor impact. we could do a temporary rateband uplift scoped to specific API keys + baked-in throttles.
matt_pm: product input: we need an acceptance criteria and rollback plan if latency or cost regressions show. propose: 48h pilot to a single region, telemetry on p50/p95 latency, token cost delta, error rate <0.5%. if threshold hit -> auto-fallback to baseline.
sam_sales: customer ok with pilot + telemetry. they asked if uplift can be immediate tomorrow morning PST.
fraud_team_bot: automated check: billing history OK, CC on file, account age 14mo, but geolocation mismatch in recent logins. request manual review from Fraud team.
julie_ops: tagging @fraud_team for manual review. also we need legal sign-off for short-term TOS amendment (burst usage).
fraud_team_bot: manual triage scheduled — flagged for 2hr review. if any anomalous session patterns or device churn -> deny uplift.
matt_pm: ok, product asks for a minimal spec to create a backlog ticket: (1) feature: temporary uplift control per-api-key, duration, hard token cap; (2) monitoring: dashboard + alert on p95 latency / token burn / errors; (3) safety: automatic rollback policy. Acceptance: run pilot with Acme w/o user-visible errors for 48h. deadline: 2 business days to prepare.
alex_support: i'll collect the A/B details and customer approval. julie, can ops implement a manual rateband and guardrails?
julie_ops: yes — we can provision a rateband and set hard caps. need a JIRA for change and ops runbook for rollback. estimate 3-4h to configure + tests.
eng_oncall: small note: prefix caching + kv warmup will reduce token costs for repeated users; recommend enabling cache for their app. include config snippet below they can use:```json
{
  "cache": "enabled",
  "ttl_secs": 3600,
  "scope": "prefix"
}
```
sam_sales: great. what's the fraud timeline? we can't promise customer start until green from Fraud.
fraud_team_bot: manual review complete: no high-risk signals, low device churn. approved pending one-time KYC doc (simple attestation).
matt_pm: product will create ticket: we need definition of done (deploy rateband, dashboards, ops runbook, signed KYC on file). linking to backlog once ticket created.
alex_support: created ticket and uploaded customer attestation. can we schedule the pilot for 09:00 PST tomorrow?
julie_ops: schedule OK. i'll run the change and stay on-call for first 2h. ops will monitor metrics and be ready to rollback.
eng_oncall: will add a temporary alert: if p95 latency > 800ms or error_rate > 0.5% trigger rollback.
sam_sales: customer notified and happy. :thumbsup:
matt_pm: thanks all — I'll track the pilot and follow up in product backlog. will create a post-pilot retro checklist. :eyes:
